prompt: Among the female competitive swimmers who won the most Olympic gold medals in a single games from 1989 to 2019, who achieved this feat at a younger age?
answer: **Missy Franklin** achieved the feat at the youngest age. She won **four gold medals at the 2012 London Olympics at age 17**, younger than Amy Van Dyken (23, 1996) and Katie Ledecky (19, 2016).
